'''StarFries''' were a snack [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] served aboard the [[Kut-Rate Kruise Lines]] transport company's [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Reasonable Doubt]]''.<ref name="Y:DR" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> [[Chuck Bratz]], a young non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] passenger on the transport, was eating a serving of StarFries along with a carton of [[Fizzy-Bip]], but put them down while playing the game [[Wookiee Warpath]] in the [[Kidz Arkade]] onboard the ship.<ref name="Y:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
StarFries first appeared in ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', a novel written by [[Sean Stewart]] that was released in [[2004]].<ref name="Y:DR" />
